newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Safilo H1 1996 profit, sales up.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Safilo H1 1996 profit, sales up.

text.p: Italian spectacle frame maker Safilo said it posted higher profit and turnover in the first half of 1996.
A statement after a board meeting said attributable consolidated net profit rose 24 percent to 15.7 billion lire from 12.6 billion in the same 1995 period.
Turnover rose to 272 billion lire from 218 billion, operating profit rose to 30.8 billion lire from 27.8 billion and cash flow increased to 29.4 billion from 24 billion.
It said sales in Italy rose by 19 percent, were up 22 percent in Europe, up 23 percent in North America and rose 52 percent in the rest of the world.
With the acquisitions earlier this year of U.S. sports sunglasses group Smith Sport Optics Inc and the Austrian group Carrera-Optyl, Safilo said it aimed for turnover of one trillion lire by 1998.
Safilo, one of the best performing stocks on the Milan stock exchange last year, was quoted 8.05 percent down at 35,400 lire at 1205 GMT on a generally weaker market.
